summary: Dolby Laboratories filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 (results of operations) and 8.01 (other events) to report fiscal Q2 2026 financial results and declare a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.36 per share payable May 20, 2026. The filing contains no M&A, restructuring, activist, or other special-situation event; it is a routine earnings release with a standard dividend declaration. No deal terms or special-situations mechanics apply, as this is an ordinary periodic update.
